ops.body: Root read phase2a a28fec0 handoff. Please ensure final acceptance includes real CLI process adapters/startup/readiness with a new isolated synckitd, not only the in-process E2E harness: install/serve/helper startup, status, sync, pickup, and the install-probe race are explicitly still unverified. Do not replace live daemons. The installed old-daemon unknown delivery.status result is a negative version-skew smoke only. Also handoff claim that deps must be released/tagged is too strong: final pushed commit pseudo-versions via go get @<sha> can make cc-sync's draft CI reproducible before component PR merges/releases; no local go.work dependency may be required in final CI. Use actual final pushed SHAs and document new synckitd requirement; don't release intermediate dependency commits just to unblock builds.
